title: Para Bellum content: population
description: Who lives where at the start, and how fast they grow. File: Content/<namespace>/population.json, exactly ONE across every namespace: the game refuses a second copy and refuses a content set with none. The military-civilian split is NOT here: it derives from the draft policy's level (policy.json), so there is one source for it. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

nations.description: One row per nation owning a province at the start.

growth_per_10k_per_year.description: Natural increase per year, per 10,000 people: births less deaths. 65 is 0.65% a year. Not negative: signed arithmetic has no agreed rounding across the two implementations.

provinces.description: One row per province. The figure is the people ON THE MAP: a province the map crops carries only its on-map share, because the rest of it is not in the game.

province.description: The province id, as the map spells it (political.province_at_start).

start_population.description: People at the start, whole persons. At least 1: zero would mean a census figure is missing, not that nobody lives there.

start_industry.description: Points of industry at the start. Each is 1 IC when manned.

ceiling.description: What agriculture can feed. A nation's ceiling is its monthly agriculture income x people_per_agriculture. Growth stops at the ceiling; a nation above it does not shrink.

people_per_agriculture.description: People fed by one unit of monthly agriculture income.

nation.description: A nation code, as the map spells it (political.country_at_start).
